title: Washmachine Playbook
description: Schema for default.yaml and any other playbook file under Assets/. Loaded by Washmachine.Core/Services/YamlCodeSnippetCatalogService.cs. The runtime validator (ValidateCatalogShape) enforces the same shape — keep both in sync. Editors with a YAML extension that supports JSON Schema (e.g. VS Code yaml-language-server) can use this for autocomplete and inline error reporting.

sections.description: Snippet sections. Each section corresponds to one selectable category in the GUI/CLI.

templates.description: C++ loader templates. Each defines an entry-point and a set of placeholders. At least one is required for the playbook to be useful.

header.description: Display label for the category. Must be unique across sections.

template.description: Stable identifier referenced by template placeholders (kind: snippet, snippetTemplate). Must be unique across sections — exact case-insensitive match is enforced.

display.description: Optional friendlier UI label. Defaults to header when omitted.

allowMultiple.description: Whether the GUI lets the operator pick more than one item from this section (e.g. anti-debug supports multiple checks).

inputs.description: Section-level inputs that apply to every item (rare).

id.description: Stable id, unique within the section. Used by snippet selection and as part of the scoped input key.

display.description: UI label for the item. Defaults to id when omitted.

default.description: Selected by default when the GUI first renders this section.

snippet.description: C++ source fragment substituted into the placeholder. May contain $token$ inputs that match this item's inputs[].id.

includes.description: Optional #include lines collected and deduplicated across all selected items.

implementation.description: Optional out-of-line C++ function bodies emitted before main().

requires.description: Capability tokens that must also be selected for this item to compile. Each token must match an entry in KnownRequiresTokens.Map (Washmachine.Core/Models/KnownRequiresTokens.cs). Unknown tokens are a hard error at catalog load — currently only 'uac_bypass' is wired.

type.description: Currently only 'textbox' is recognized; other values fall through to TextBox.

placement.description: Where the input sits relative to the snippet selector.

preamble.description: Optional template-specific C++ preamble appended to the shared {{PREAMBLE}} block.

content.description: C++ source with {{TOKEN}} placeholders. Standard system tokens: PREAMBLE, SNIPPET_INCLUDES, SNIPPET_IMPLEMENTATIONS, PROCESS_LOOKUP_HELPER, SHELLCODE_SOURCE, SHELLCODE_URL, GUARDRAILS, ANTI_DEBUGGING, UAC_BYPASS, PROCESS_INJECTION, SHELLCODE_EXECUTION.

name.description: The {{NAME}} token to substitute in template.content.

kind.description: system: filled by CompilerService from the request. snippet: filled by user selection from the section identified by snippetTemplate.

snippetTemplate.description: When kind=snippet, the template name of the section to draw items from. Must match a section's 'template' field exactly (case-insensitive).
